entry.author: Ministry for Ethnic Communities
entry.summary:
Her Excellency Ms Mazita Marzuki, High Commissioner of Malaysia, His Excellency Mr Phan Minh Giang, Ambassador of Vietnam and Her Excellency Ms Neeta Bhushan, High Commissioner of India discuss opportunities for global collaboration and the ways ethnic entrepreneurs can strengthen bilateral economic ties.

This discussion was part of a panel session at the Ministry for Ethnic Communities' business symposium, Ethnic Xchange 2025 (EX25).
